AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Animal Feed: Hay and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Leftover Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Integrated Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
